integrity.computational_evidence: No computation or finite enumeration is used as proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact component-utility algebra plus the published AM-GM upper bound.

scientific_limitations: The bound is for the frictionless model with odd n >= 3 and 0 < p <= q, p+q <= 1.
The result establishes a sharp inverse-population order for the gap but does not classify globally optimal odd-order graphs.
The constants are for fixed admissible p and q; no uniform statement is made when parameters vary with n.
title: A sharp inverse-population welfare gap for odd professional networks
